title: Domestic Pressure Cookers — Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: Specifies design, construction, safety devices, and testing requirements for domestic pressure cookers manufactured from aluminium alloys, stainless steel, or composite materials with capacities from 1 to 22 litres.
summary: Mandatory safety standard for domestic pressure cookers. Requires spring-loaded or weight-loaded safety valves, fusible plugs, gasket release systems, and mandatory hydrostatic pressure testing at 2.5 times operating pressure.
qco_notification: Domestic Pressure Cooker (Quality Control) Order, 2020 issued by DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry under Section 16 of BIS Act 2016.
penalty_clause: Section 29 of BIS Act 2016: Imprisonment up to two years or fine up to ₹5,00,000 or both for non-certified manufacture or sale.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Mechanical Engineering Division MED-32)

clauses.title: Material Specifications
clauses.content: Body and lid shall be fabricated from food-grade aluminium conforming to IS 21 or austenitic stainless steel grade 304 (04Cr18Ni10) conforming to IS 6911. Gasket must be non-toxic food-grade nitrile or silicone rubber conforming to IS 7466.

clauses.title: Safety Devices & Relief Mechanisms
clauses.content: Every cooker shall be equipped with at least two independent safety relief mechanisms: (a) a weight or spring loaded operating pressure valve regulating nominal pressure between 0.9 to 1.1 bar, and (b) a fusible plug or gasket release mechanism activating before pressure exceeds 2.0 bar.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Proof Pressure Test
clauses.content: The assembled cooker body shall withstand an internal hydrostatic pressure test of not less than 250 kPa (2.5 bar) for a minimum duration of 2 minutes without leakage, structural distortion, or permanent deformation.

clauses.title: Mandatory Marking & Packaging
clauses.content: Each pressure cooker shall be legibly marked on body and lid with: (a) Manufacturer's name or trademark, (b) Rated capacity in litres, (c) Standard Mark (ISI) with CM/L license number, and (d) Year/batch of manufacture.

title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders — Specification
scope: Specifies constructional, dimensional, retention, and impact absorption criteria for protective helmets for riders and pillion passengers of two-wheeled motor vehicles.
summary: Mandatory life safety standard enforcing high-velocity impact attenuation, penetration resistance against conical drop weights, dynamic retention harness strength, and peripheral field of vision exceeding 105 degrees.
qco_notification: Helmet for Two-Wheeler Riders (Quality Control) Order enforced nationwide by Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH).
penalty_clause: Motor Vehicles Act Section 129 read with BIS Act 2016 Section 29: Seizure of goods, criminal prosecution, and manufacturer fine up to ₹5,00,000.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Transport Engineering Division TED-07)

clauses.title: Shell & Impact Liner Construction
clauses.content: Outer shell shall be moulded from high-impact polycarbonate, ABS, or fiberglass reinforced resin with minimum thickness of 2.8 mm. Energy-absorbing liner must be expanded polystyrene (EPS) with minimum density of 35 g/L.

clauses.title: Impact Absorption Test Protocol
clauses.content: Helmet mounted on a tri-axial headform shall be dropped from a height of 2.8 meters onto flat and hemispherical steel anvils at ambient, high (+50°C), and low (-20°C) temperatures. Peak acceleration transmitted to headform shall not exceed 300 g.

clauses.title: Penetration Resistance
clauses.content: A metal striker weighing 3 kg with a sharp conical point shall drop from a height of 1.0 meter onto any point of the outer shell. The tip of the striker must not make electrical contact with the headform.

clauses.title: Dynamic Retention Harness Strength
clauses.content: Chin strap retention system shall be subjected to dynamic tensile shock loading. Total elongation shall not exceed 25 mm, and residual slippage must not exceed 10 mm.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Natural Mineral Water) — Specification
scope: Prescribes microbiological, physical, chemical, and heavy metal parameters for purified water filled in sealed hermetic containers for direct human consumption.
summary: Mandatory food safety standard under FSSAI and BIS QCO. Demands multi-barrier treatment including filtration, reverse osmosis / demineralization, UV disinfection, and ozonation. Zero tolerance for pathogens and total coliform.
qco_notification: Packaged Drinking Water Compulsory Certification Order issued jointly by Ministry of Consumer Affairs and Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI).
penalty_clause: Section 29 of BIS Act 2016 & FSSAI Section 58: Immediate plant sealing, cancellation of trade license, and criminal complaint.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Food & Agriculture Division FAD-14)

clauses.title: Hygienic Source & Multi-Barrier Treatment
clauses.content: Water shall be derived from potable municipal or groundwater sources and treated by aeration, coagulation, sand filtration, activated carbon absorption, reverse osmosis or demineralization, UV irradiation, and ozonation.

clauses.title: Microbiological Criteria (Pathogen Absolutes)
clauses.content: Escherichia coli, coliform bacteria, fecal streptococci, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and yeast/mould must be absent in 250 ml of sample. Aerobic microbial count at 37°C shall not exceed 20 CFU/ml.

clauses.title: Toxic Heavy Metals & Chemical Tolerances
clauses.content: Total dissolved solids (TDS) must be between 75 and 500 mg/l. Heavy metal limits: Lead maximum 0.01 mg/l, Arsenic 0.01 mg/l, Cadmium 0.003 mg/l, Mercury 0.001 mg/l, and Pesticide residues non-detectable.

clauses.title: Packaging in Food-Grade Polymers
clauses.content: Containers must be manufactured from virgin, food-grade PET (IS 12252) or Polycarbonate (IS 14971), tamper-evident, and clearly labelled with batch number, processing date, and ISI mark with CM/L number.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for steel plates, sections, strips, and bars for use in structural steel fabrications, bridges, pressure vessels, transmission towers, and high-rise buildings.
summary: Mandatory civil engineering standard categorizing steel across yield strength grades (E250, E300, E350, E410, E450). Mandates chemical limits on carbon, sulfur, phosphorus, and Charpy V-notch impact toughness.
qco_notification: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020 issued by Ministry of Steel, Government of India.
penalty_clause: Section 29 of BIS Act 2016: Confiscation of imported or domestic consignment and maximum statutory penalty.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Metallurgical Engineering Division MTD-04)

clauses.title: Chemical Composition Limits
clauses.content: Grade E250 quality A: Carbon max 0.23%, Manganese max 1.50%, Sulfur max 0.045%, Phosphorus max 0.045%, Silicon max 0.40%. Carbon equivalent (CE) based on ladle analysis shall not exceed 0.42%.

clauses.title: Mechanical Tensile & Yield Properties
clauses.content: For thickness < 20 mm: Minimum Yield Strength 250 MPa, Tensile Strength 410 to 540 MPa, and minimum elongation of 23% measured on gauge length 5.65√So.

clauses.title: Bend & Impact Toughness Test
clauses.content: Bend test pieces shall withstand 180° cold bend around mandrel diameter equal to 2t without fracture. Grade C/D requires Charpy V-notch impact absorption of min 27 Joules at 0°C / -20°C.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services — Part 1: Safety Requirements
scope: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements, together with test methods, for self-ballasted LED lamps having a rated wattage up to 60W and rated voltage up to 250V AC.
summary: Mandatory standard under MeitY Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS). Governs dielectric insulation resistance, resistance to heat and fire (glow wire test at 650°C), fault condition safety, and creepage distances.
qco_notification: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order by MeitY.
penalty_clause: Electronics QCO Section 16 & 29: Ban on commercial distribution, port customs seizure of imported electronics, and criminal liability.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Electrotechnical Division ETD-23)

clauses.title: Marking Requirements for CRS
clauses.content: Lamps must be legibly marked with: (a) Mark of origin, (b) Rated voltage, (c) Rated wattage, (d) Rated frequency, and (e) BIS CRS Registration Symbol with valid R-number (R-XXXXXXXX).

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance & Electric Strength
clauses.content: Insulation resistance between live parts and accessible external metal parts shall not be less than 4 Megohms at 500V DC. Dielectric strength must withstand 2U + 1000V AC without flashover.

clauses.title: Resistance to Heat and Fire (Glow Wire)
clauses.content: External parts of insulating material providing protection against electric shock shall withstand the glow wire test at 650°C in accordance with IS 11000 (Part 2/Sec 1).

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety — Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Applies to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment including laptops, personal computers, mobile phones, tablet computers, POS terminals, and power supplies.
summary: Core safety standard under Scheme-II (CRS) addressing hazard protection: electric shock, energy hazards, fire propagation, mechanical and heat hazards, radiation, and chemical emission.
qco_notification: MeitY Compulsory Registration Order Schedule Phase I & II.
penalty_clause: Immediate blocking of BIS CRS registration certificate, custom hold at Indian ports of entry, and market recall.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Electronics & IT Division LITD-07)

clauses.title: Components & Flammability Classification
clauses.content: Polymeric enclosures and internal insulation materials must have a minimum flammability classification of V-1 or V-0 when tested in accordance with IS 11731 / IEC 60695-11-10.

clauses.title: Protection Against Electric Shock
clauses.content: Operator accessible areas shall be isolated from primary hazardous live voltages by double or reinforced insulation with clearance distances exceeding 4.0 mm and creepage distances exceeding 5.0 mm.

clauses.title: Mechanical Drop and Impact Strength
clauses.content: Handheld equipment such as mobile phones and tablets must withstand 3 successive drop impacts from a height of 1000 mm onto a rigid horizontal hardwood surface without creating safety hazards.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Bullion and Artefacts — Fineness and Marking
scope: Specifies 6 recognized purity fineness grades for gold jewellery, artefacts, and bullion, along with mandatory hallmark laser marking protocols.
summary: Statutory Hallmarking standard enforcing mandatory hallmarking across 288+ notified districts in India. Each gold article must carry: (1) BIS Hallmark logo, (2) Purity grade (e.g., 22K916), and (3) Unique 6-digit alphanumeric HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification).
qco_notification: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order enforced by Department of Consumer Affairs.
penalty_clause: Section 29 of BIS Act 2016: Fine of minimum ₹1,00,000 or up to 5 times the market value of the gold article, plus suspension of jeweller portal license.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Assaying and Hallmarking Division MTD-10)

clauses.title: Official Recognized Fineness Grades
clauses.content: Gold jewellery shall be assayed and certified strictly into one of 6 fineness grades: 24K (999 parts per thousand), 23K (958), 22K (916), 20K (833), 18K (750), and 14K (585).

clauses.title: Three-Symbol Mandatory Hallmark Composition
clauses.content: Every hallmarked gold article must bear three laser-engraved symbols: (a) The official triangular BIS Standard Mark, (b) Purity and Fineness notation (e.g., 22K916), and (c) 6-character alphanumeric Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) assigned by a BIS-recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centre (AHC).

clauses.title: Fire Assay Verification Protocol
clauses.content: Purity must be verified using the standard lead fire assay method (cupellation) in accordance with IS 1418, ensuring precision within ± 0.5 parts per thousand.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (TMT Rebars)
scope: Specifies mechanical properties, nominal cross-sectional areas, and rib geometries for thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) steel reinforcement bars used in reinforced cement concrete (RCC) structures.
summary: Essential construction safety standard covering grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600. 'D' grades mandate high ductility for earthquake-resistant construction.
qco_notification: Steel and Steel Products QCO by Ministry of Steel.
penalty_clause: BIS Act 2016 Section 29: Immediate shutdown of re-rolling mills operating without active CM/L license.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Civil Engineering Division CED-54)

clauses.title: Thermo-Mechanical Treatment (TMT) Quenching
clauses.content: Steel bars must be hot-rolled from certified prime billets and subjected to in-line controlled water quenching and self-tempering to yield a composite structure consisting of a tempered martensitic outer rim and a ductile ferrite-pearlite core.

clauses.title: Strength & High Ductility Tolerances
clauses.content: For Fe 500D grade: 0.2% Proof Stress min 500.0 MPa, Tensile to Proof stress ratio (UTS/YS) not less than 1.10, and Total Elongation at fracture min 16.0% with Uniform Elongation min 5.0%.

clauses.title: Rebend Test for Earthquake Resistance
clauses.content: Test pieces shall be bent through an angle of 135°, placed in boiling water at 100°C for 30 minutes, cooled, and reverse-bent through 157.5° without displaying cracks or fissures.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Governs safety of electrical appliances for household, commercial, and similar purposes whose rated voltage is not more than 250V single-phase or 480V for other appliances.
summary: Umbrella standard covering general electrical safety across kitchen mixers, geysers, irons, toasters, refrigerators, and washing machines. Governs earthing, protection against live contact, moisture resistance, and insulation.
qco_notification: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order by DPIIT.
penalty_clause: BIS Act 2016 Section 29: Up to 2 years imprisonment or fine up to ₹5,00,000.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Electrotechnical Division ETD-32)

clauses.title: Protection Against Access to Live Parts
clauses.content: Appliances shall be so constructed that there is adequate protection against accidental contact with live parts when tested with standard test probe B of IS 1401.

clauses.title: Electric Leakage Current & Dielectric Strength
clauses.content: Leakage current under operating temperature shall not exceed 0.75 mA for portable Class I appliances. Dielectric withstand test requires 1250V AC applied across live parts and accessible chassis for 60 seconds.

clauses.title: Earthing Continuity & Provision
clauses.content: Accessible metal parts of Class I appliances must be permanently and reliably connected to an earthing terminal. Earthing circuit resistance must not exceed 0.1 ohm when tested with a 25A current.

title: Drinking Water — Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Prescribes quality standards for drinking water supplied for human consumption by municipal corporations, piped water schemes (Jal Jeevan Mission), and community suppliers.
summary: Benchmark national water purity standard defining acceptable and permissible limits in the absence of an alternate source for 48 physical, chemical, pesticide, and bacteriological characteristics.
certification_scheme: Voluntary for Municipal / Mandatory for Public Supply Schemes
qco_notification: Mandatory standard under Jal Jeevan Mission and Central Public Health Environmental Engineering Organization (CPHEEO).
penalty_clause: Consumer Protection Act 2019 read with Environment Protection Act 1986.
authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (Food & Agriculture Division FAD-14)

clauses.title: Physical & Organoleptic Parameters
clauses.content: Turbidity: Acceptable limit 1 NTU (max 5 NTU in absence of alternate source); pH: 6.5 to 8.5; Total Dissolved Solids (TDS): Acceptable limit 500 mg/l (max 2000 mg/l); Total Hardness: Acceptable 200 mg/l (max 600 mg/l).

clauses.title: Bacteriological Quality Standards
clauses.content: All water intended for drinking must have zero E. coli or thermo-tolerant coliform bacteria in any 100 ml sample. For treated piped water, total coliform must be zero in 95% of samples collected throughout the year.

clauses.title: Toxic Substances & Heavy Metal Thresholds
clauses.content: Arsenic max 0.01 mg/l (no relaxation); Lead max 0.01 mg/l; Fluoride acceptable 1.0 mg/l (max 1.5 mg/l); Nitrate max 45 mg/l; Chromium (hexavalent) max 0.05 mg/l.
